name: com.tfrooms/tf-rooms
title: TF Rooms
description: New Leaf properties: twelve in Twin Falls, Idaho, plus High Country Motel in Bellevue.

tools.name: find_rooms
tools.description:
Which New Leaf property has a room free tonight or on particular nights. With no dates it answers for tonight and says so.
Twin Falls properties (twelve): checks all twelve live for the requested dates. The published availability feeds carry CAPACITY, not vacancy, and say nothing about which nights are taken. It applies each property's live minimum stay: a single or a double can be one night, subject to availability, and a studio is 7 nights or more. For a stay under a week with a room free it gives the nightly rates. A stay over 30 nights is refused before anything else: every Twin Falls stay is capped at 30 days.
High Country Motel, Bellevue (separate; Twin Falls rates and tax do not apply): Single and Double availability comes from its own counted inventory. 766 S Main St, Bellevue, Idaho, about 64 road miles north of Twin Falls; also run by New Leaf Properties. Rates from $115 a night, $600 a week, $1,490 a month, plus applicable taxes. Subject to availability. Single accommodates 1 to 2 guests; Double accommodates 1 to 4 guests. Half-kitchenette mini suites are Doubles. High Country taxes total 11% for stays of 30 days or less: Idaho sales 6%, Idaho travel and convention 2%, and Bellevue local option 3%. Longer continuous stays may be exempt; ask the front desk. Estimated price, based on our starting rates. The front desk will confirm your exact rate and total, including all applicable taxes, before your stay. No payment is taken online. New Leaf office: (208) 733-2010. Book online, by phone at (208) 721-0067 (front desk), or through booking-enabled chat. Your request requires staff confirmation. Chat stays are capped at 30 nights; longer stays through the front desk. Book a room: https://highcountrymotelid.com/reserve.html

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description:
Validates and prices a stay, checks current availability without holding a room, and emails a six-digit code. It prices and validates the stay, so no separate quote is needed first. Requires the property, room type, dates, guest name, email and contact phone. If the guest already gave a name, email or phone in this chat, use them and ask only for what is missing. The intent and code last 15 minutes. An identical start while its intent remains open returns the same booking_id without another email; that booking_id can resend the code. A start with any changed detail replaces the earlier unproved intent at the same property. No stored contact stays are read before verification; the phone affects no pre-verification limit. Each normalized email can receive at most three booking codes per hour and six per rolling 24 hours across the portfolio. Configurable portfolio hourly and rolling daily ceilings and a property hourly ceiling apply; booking codes pause if the hub counter cannot confirm both budgets within two seconds. Reaching a ceiling returns the requested stay link and property phone. The resend mode takes only booking_id; at most two resends are allowed, at least 60 seconds apart. A room is held only after email-code verification succeeds. If chat booking is switched off, returns the prefilled reserve.html link.
High Country Motel, Bellevue (separate; Twin Falls rates and tax do not apply): accepts single or double room requests, up to 30 nights, with a starting-rate estimate and staff confirmation required. Ask about pets and put the explicit answer on its own notes line as Pets: Yes or Pets: No; service animals are not pets. Pet deposits are outside the estimated room total.

tools.name: confirm_booking
tools.description:
Verifies the code the guest received by email for a booking_id, then holds an available room and submits the reservation for staff confirmation within 24 hours. Requires that booking_id and six-digit code. Repeating the same valid pair returns the same reservation. After email proof, checks stays matching only that proved email, overlapping dates and the 30-day continuous-stay limit, including a one-night gap. Starting over with the proved email for the same property, room type and dates returns the existing held chat reservation. Contact-based refusals give only the requested stay link and property phone. The guest brings photo ID and signs the guest agreement at check-in; no payment is taken.
High Country Motel, Bellevue (separate; Twin Falls rates and tax do not apply): returns its saved estimated price; the front desk confirms the exact rate and total. Your request requires staff confirmation.

tools.name: get_reservation_link
tools.description: The link to the TF Rooms reservation page on tfrooms.com, in English and Spanish, where a guest looks up or cancels an existing reservation by entering its reservation number and the last four digits of the contact phone. This connector does not read, look up or cancel a reservation, and preparing the link sends nothing. Cancellation on the page needs a six-digit code emailed to the booking address and is available more than 48 hours before the 3 PM check-in during office hours; other cancellations are made by phone with the property. The published cancellation policy applies; no payment or refund is processed. Returns the page link with the client's source label, the cancellation policy link and the New Leaf office phone and hours.
